mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) compress equity discount rates, increasing present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rates exceeding 4.5% signal monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent federal funds rates above 4.0% and unemployment rates above 5.0% indicate recessionary conditions that depress equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0 AND UNRATE > 5.0 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion conditions (HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 450000) signal robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1200 AND RSAFS > 450000 and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market conditions (PAYEMS > 144000) signal sustained consumer spending and corporate earnings momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 144000 and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates exceeding 5.0% signal economic distress that reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 and CPI exceeding 240 indicate supply shock with inflationary pressure that increases equity risk premiums, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 AND CPIAUCSL > 240 and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI exceeding 240 signals inflationary pressure that triggers monetary policy tightening expectations, reducing equity real returns and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 240 and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
